questions.q: Does the server-side onboarding-completion check (OB-2, App.tsx ProtectedRoute) correctly distinguish a workspace OWNER's own unfinished onboarding from an invited guest's session, so an invitee isn't wrongly sent to the onboarding wizard?
questions.a: Yes. OnboardingService.getBrandOnboardingStatus (OnboardingService.java:109-115) OR's user.isOnboardingCompleted() with isGuestInCurrentWorkspace (java:126-130), which returns true whenever the caller's role in the CURRENT workspace isn't OWNER. Verified in source and by running OnboardingServiceWorkspaceGuardTest (mvn -Dtest, exit 0).

questions.q: Is POST /workspace/members/accept truly gated by an authenticated principal plus an email match, closing the 'public, no-auth accept' hole the original task brief described?
questions.a: Yes. WorkspaceMemberService.acceptInvite (java:197-258) requires a normal AuthPrincipal (not in SecurityConfig permitAll) and rejects when principal.getEmail() != invite.getEmail() (INVITE_EMAIL_MISMATCH, 403). Verified via acceptInvite_emailMismatch_rejected and acceptInvite_happyPath_createsMemberAndMarksAccepted (mvn run, exit 0).

questions.q: Can DELETE /workspace/members/{memberId} ever leave a workspace with zero active OWNERs?
questions.a: No. deactivateMember (WorkspaceMemberService.java:265-298) counts active OWNERs and throws CANNOT_REMOVE_SOLE_OWNER (409) when activeOwners <= 1 before deactivating. Verified via deactivateMember_soleOwnerProtected (mvn run, exit 0).

questions.q: Does the LIVE workspace-switch endpoint (POST /workspace/members/switch) check workspace.isSuspended() to prevent indefinite session renewal on a suspended workspace, per the F-0457 fix note in the code?
questions.a: Yes, verified in source (WorkspaceMemberService.java:394-406) and via switchWorkspace_suspendedTarget_rejected test (mvn run, exit 0). A second, textually-identical guard also now exists in the DEAD WorkspaceService.switchWorkspace copy (java:189-194), but nothing routes to it (see finding on duplication).

questions.q: Is the seat-limit enforcement resistant to a plan downgrade or a race between an invite and an accept?
questions.a: Enforced twice by design (invite time against active+pending, accept time against active alone) per WorkspaceMemberService.java:50-57,246-248. Verified via acceptInvite_seatLimitReCheckedAtAcceptTime and inviteMember_atCapWithPendingInvites_rejected (mvn run, exit 0).

questions.q: Is there a working role-change (promote/demote) capability for an existing team member once invited/accepted?
questions.a: No. WorkspaceMemberDtos.ChangeRoleRequest (java:33-34) and WorkspaceMember.changeRole(MemberRole) (WorkspaceMember.java:107-109) exist, but grep across the entire influora-api/src/main tree finds no WorkspaceMemberService.changeRole method and no controller mapping (WorkspaceMemberController has @RequestMapping("/workspace/members") with no PATCH .../role route). features.name: Team members — invite / accept / remove / list / invites / revoke / switch
features.user_type: brand OWNER/ADMIN (invite/remove/list-invites/revoke); any active member (list); the invitee (accept, once authenticated); any active member (switch)
features.purpose: Seat-based team management: invite a colleague by email+role, redeem the invite, list/remove active members, list/revoke outstanding invites, and switch the caller's session between workspaces they belong to.
features.flow: team-members-panel.tsx -> api.workspaceMembers.{list,inviteMember,listInvites,revokeInvite,deactivateMember} -> WorkspaceMemberController -> WorkspaceMemberService -> WorkspaceMemberRepository/WorkspaceMemberInviteRepository/UserRepository/EmailOutboxRepository/Msg91EmailClient -> WorkspaceMember/WorkspaceMemberInvite entities -> ApiResponse -> UI; brand-accept-invite.tsx -> api.workspaceMembers.acceptInvite -> WorkspaceMemberService.acceptInvite -> enterWorkspace() -> api.workspaceMembers.switchWorkspace -> new JWT access token -> dashboard
features.api: POST /workspace/members/invite, POST /workspace/members/accept, DELETE /workspace/members/{memberId}, GET /workspace/members, GET /workspace/members/invites, POST /workspace/members/invites/{inviteId}/revoke, POST /workspace/members/switch
features.database: workspace_members (id, workspace_id, user_id, role, active, created_at); workspace_member_invites (id, workspace_id, email, role, status PENDING/ACCEPTED/EXPIRED/REVOKED, invite_token_hash, expires_at); email_outbox (for an invitee with an existing account); users.active_workspace_id (rememberActiveWorkspace on switch)
features.state_machine: Invite: PENDING -> ACCEPTED | REVOKED | EXPIRED (lazily flipped on an expired accept attempt too). Member: created active=true -> deactivate() sets active=false (soft delete, never hard-deleted).
features.authn: JWT on every route including /accept (explicitly NOT public, despite the original task brief calling it public — WorkspaceMemberService.java:65-77 javadoc)
features.authz: invite/remove/list-invites/revoke: OWNER/ADMIN via requireRole; list: any active member; accept: caller's own account email must equal invite.getEmail(); switch: caller must already be an active member of the target workspace
features.working_condition: An OWNER/ADMIN invites an email; the invitee (after logging in with that exact email) redeems the token via /accept, gets a workspace_members row, and can then use /switch to move their session into that workspace and back to their own.
features.failure_conditions: Seat cap reached -> UPGRADE_REQUIRED 402 (active+pending accounting); duplicate pending invite -> resent, not duplicated; invite email mismatch -> 403 INVITE_EMAIL_MISMATCH; expired/revoked/already-accepted invite -> 410/409; deactivating the sole active OWNER -> 409 CANNOT_REMOVE_SOLE_OWNER; switching to a suspended workspace -> 403 WORKSPACE_SUSPENDED (F-0457 fix)
features.security_conditions: F-0457 (CRITICAL, already fixed in this RC): switchWorkspace mints a fresh 15-minute access token and now checks workspace.isSuspended() first, closing a path that let a suspended workspace's holder mint tokens forever without ever hitting /auth/refresh's suspension gate.
